shortDescription: Modifies settings of the PostgreSQL instance

options.name: cpu_count
options.description: Specifies a number of CPU cores that you want to assign to a machine  where the PostgreSQL instance is installed

options.name: dump_to_file
options.description: Only required if PostgreSQL is on a remote server and VBR is not currently using it as a DB for VBR Generates a SQL query in a file. The query settings can then be applied to the machine where the PostgreSQL instance is installed

options.name: os_type
options.description: Only required if PostgreSQL is on a remote server Specifies the OS of the machine where the PostgreSQL instance is installed Set to C(Windows) if PosgreSQL is installed on Windows Set to C(Linux) if PosgreSQL is installed on Linux

options.name: ram_gb
options.description: Specifies amount of memory in GB that you want to assign to a machine  where the PostgreSQL instance is installed
